record.paper_title: Periods of Integrals on Algebraic Manifolds: Summary of Main Results and Discussion of Open Problems
record.context_brief: Deligne limit mixed Hodge structure conjecture
record.original_question: For a one-parameter degeneration whose Picard-Lefschetz transformation T on E=H^q(V_s,C) is unipotent, does the Picard-Lefschetz filtration W induced by log T, together with the limiting Hodge filtration, define graded Hodge structures of the appropriate weights on W^k/W^{k-1}, polarized on the primitive pieces by the bilinear forms built from Q and log T, with the filtrations varying holomorphically over the punctured disc and extending across the central point so that log T maps the limiting filtration as required?

evidence.quote: Deligne's conjecture relates the Hodge filtration of §1
is a Hodge filtration of weight k on Wk/Wk

artifact.status_search_result: Deligne's conjecture on the limit mixed Hodge structure for a one-parameter degeneration with unipotent monodromy was proved by W. Schmid in his 1973 work "Variation of Hodge structure: The singularities of the period mapping" (Invent. Math. 22), via the Nilpotent Orbit Theorem and SL_2-Orbit Theorem. The existence and holomorphic extension of the limiting Hodge filtration, the purity of the induced Hodge structures on the graded pieces of the monodromy weight filtration, and the polarization of the primitive parts by Q(·, N^k ·) are all established there. Generalizations to several variables (Cattani–Kaplan–Schmid) and to admissible variations of mixed Hodge structure (Steenbrink–Zucker, Kashiwara) further confirm and extend the result.

status_evidence.title: Variation of Hodge structure: The singularities of the period mapping (W. Schmid)
status_evidence.snippet: Schmid establishes the nilpotent orbit theorem and SL_2-orbit theorem, proving the existence of the limiting Hodge filtration and that, together with the monodromy weight filtration, it defines a polarized mixed Hodge structure.
status_evidence.claim: Schmid (1973) proved Deligne's limit mixed Hodge structure conjecture for one-parameter unipotent degenerations.

status_evidence.title: Introduction to Limit Mixed Hodge Structures (D. Arapura)
status_evidence.snippet: The limit mixed Hodge structure, following Schmid, is built from the monodromy weight filtration and limiting Hodge filtration; it is a polarized mixed Hodge structure.
status_evidence.claim: Standard expositions confirm the conjecture is a theorem of Schmid.
